payload.rebuttal: fixed: The queue.json snapshot that was being compared to [other_row] was taken before run_task was even called, so a QUEUED row written by run_task just before invoking run_one_cell would be silently overwritten by the first live write (same repo+spec_id key) and never show up in that snapshot. The fix moves the snapshot to the first line inside the run_one_cell fake itself, which runs after any such pre-write but before any on_state call, so it now sees a QUEUED row if one was written. Verified by applying the exact wrong version the finding describes and confirming the test fails, then reverting it and confirming the test passes.
